shloka_text: सुमाली वरलब्धांस्तु ज्ञात्वा चैतान्निशाचरान् । उदतिष्ठद्भयं त्यक्त्वा सानुगः स रसातलात् ।। 7.11.1 ।।
transliteration: sumālī varalabdhāṃstu jñātvā caitānniśācarān | udatiṣṭhadbhayaṃ tyaktvā sānugaḥ sa rasātalāt || 7.11.1 ||
translation: सुमाली Sumali, वरलब्धान् those who had obtained boons, तु indeed, ज्ञात्वा having known, च and, एतान् these, निशाचरान् night-wanderers, उदतिष्ठत् rose up, भयम् fear, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, सानुगः with his followers, सः he, रसातलात् from Rasatala
explanation: Sumali, having learned that these night-wanderers had obtained boons, rose up from Rasatala with his followers, abandoning all fear.
comments: Sumali rises from Rasatala and urges Ravana to wrest Lanka back from Kubera -- though Ravana first demurs out of respect for his elder brother, Prahasta persuades him, and an envoy is sent demanding the city -- consulting his father Vishravas, Kubera is counselled to yield to the boon-emboldened, cursed Ravana and withdraws to Mount Kailasa -- Ravana enters Lanka and is crowned its king.

shloka_text: मारीचश्च प्रहस्तश्च विरूपाक्षो महोदरः । उदतिष्ठन्सुसंरब्धाः सचिवास्तस्य रक्षसः ।। 7.11.2 ।।
transliteration: mārīcaśca prahastaśca virūpākṣo mahodaraḥ | udatiṣṭhansusaṃrabdhāḥ sacivāstasya rakṣasaḥ || 7.11.2 ||
translation: मारीचः Maricha, च and, प्रहस्तः Prahasta, च and, विरूपाक्षः Virupaksha, महोदरः Mahodara, उदतिष्ठन् rose up, सुसंरब्धाः greatly excited, सचिवाः ministers, तस्य his, रक्षसः of the Rakshasa
explanation: Maricha, Prahasta, Virupaksha, and Mahodara, who were the greatly excited ministers of that Rakshasa (Sumali), also rose up.

shloka_text: सुमाली सचिवैः सार्धं वृतो राक्षसपुङ्गवैः । अभिगम्य दशग्रीवं परिष्वज्येदमब्रवीत् ।। 7.11.3 ।।
transliteration: sumālī sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ vṛto rākṣasapuṅgavaiḥ | abhigamya daśagrīvaṃ pariṣvajyedamabravīt || 7.11.3 ||
translation: सुमाली Sumali, सचिवैः with ministers, सार्धम् together, वृतः surrounded, राक्षसपुङ्गवैः by chief Rakshasas, अभिगम्य having approached, दशग्रीवम् Dashagriva, परिष्वज्य having embraced, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke
explanation: Sumali, surrounded by his ministers and other chief Rakshasas, approached Dashagriva, embraced him, and spoke these words.

shloka_text: दिष्ट्या ते वत्स सम्प्राप्तश्चिन्तितो ऽयं मनोरथः । यस्त्वं त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठाल्लब्धवान्वरमुत्तमम् ।। 7.11.4 ।।
transliteration: diṣṭyā te vatsa samprāptaścintito 'yaṃ manorathaḥ | yastvaṃ tribhuvanaśreṣṭhāllabdhavānvaramuttamam || 7.11.4 ||
translation: दिष्ट्या fortunately, ते to you, वत्स O son, सम्प्राप्तः achieved, चिन्तितः thought of, अयम् this, मनोरथः desire, यत् that, त्वम् you, त्रिभुवनश्रेष्ठात् from the best of the three worlds, लब्धवान् have obtained, वरम् boon, उत्तमम् excellent
explanation: Fortunately, O son, this cherished desire of yours has been achieved, as you have obtained an excellent boon from the best of the three worlds (Brahma).

shloka_text: यत्कृते च वयं लङ्कां त्यकत्वा याता रसातलम् । तद्गतं नो महाबाहो महद्विष्णुकृतं भयम् ।। 7.11.5 ।।
transliteration: yatkṛte ca vayaṃ laṅkāṃ tyakatvā yātā rasātalam | tadgataṃ no mahābāho mahadviṣṇukṛtaṃ bhayam || 7.11.5 ||
translation: यत्कृते for whom, च and, वयम् we, लङ्काम् Lanka, त्यकत्वा having abandoned, याताः went, रसातलम् to Rasatala, तत् that, गतम् gone, नः our, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, महत् great, विष्णुकृतम् caused by Vishnu, भयम् fear.
explanation: O mighty-armed one, the great fear caused by Vishnu, for which we abandoned Lanka and went to Rasatala, has now departed from us.

shloka_text: असकृत्तद्भयाद्भीताः परित्यज्य स्वमालयम् । विद्रुताः सहिताः सर्वे प्रविष्टाः स्म रसातलम् ।। 7.11.6 ।।
transliteration: asakṛttadbhayādbhītāḥ parityajya svamālayam | vidrutāḥ sahitāḥ sarve praviṣṭāḥ sma rasātalam || 7.11.6 ||
translation: असकृत् repeatedly, तद्भयात् from that fear, भीताः frightened, परित्यज्य having abandoned, स्वम् our own, आलयम् abode, विद्रुताः fled, सहिताः together, सर्वे all, प्रविष्टाः entered, स्म (past tense indicator), रसातलम् Rasatala.
explanation: Frightened repeatedly by that fear, all of us together abandoned our own abode and fled, entering Rasatala.

shloka_text: अस्मदीया च लङ्केयं नगरी राक्षसोचिता । निवेशिता तव भ्रात्रा धनाध्यक्षेण धीमता ।। 7.11.7 ।।
transliteration: asmadīyā ca laṅkeyaṃ nagarī rākṣasocitā | niveśitā tava bhrātrā dhanādhyakṣeṇa dhīmatā || 7.11.7 ||
translation: अस्मदीया ours, च and, लङ्का Lanka, इयम् this, नगरी city, राक्षसोचिता suitable for Rakshasas, निवेशिता established, तव your, भ्रात्रा by brother, धनाध्यक्षेण by the lord of wealth, धीमता by the intelligent one.
explanation: This city of Lanka, suitable for Rakshasas, was established by your intelligent brother, the lord of wealth (Kubera), and belongs to us.

shloka_text: यदि नामात्र शक्यं स्यात्साम्ना दानेन वानघ । तरसा वा महाबाहो प्रत्यानेतुं कृतं भवेत् ।। 7.11.8 ।।
transliteration: yadi nāmātra śakyaṃ syātsāmnā dānena vānagha | tarasā vā mahābāho pratyānetuṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet || 7.11.8 ||
translation: यदि if, न not, अत्र here, शक्यम् possible, स्यात् it would be, साम्ना by conciliation, दानेन by giving, वा or, अनघ O sinless one, तरसा by force, वा or, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, प्रत्यानेतुम् to bring back, कृतम् done, भवेत् it would be.
explanation: O sinless and mighty-armed one, if it is not possible to bring it back by conciliation or by gifts, then it should be done by force.

shloka_text: त्वं तु लङ्केश्वरस्तात भविष्यसि न संशयः । त्वया राक्षसवंशो ऽयं निमग्नो ऽपि समुद्धृतः । सर्वेषां नः प्रभुश्चैव भविष्यसि महाबल ।। 7.11.9 ।।
transliteration: tvaṃ tu laṅkeśvarastāta bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ | tvayā rākṣasavaṃśo 'yaṃ nimagno 'pi samuddhṛtaḥ | sarveṣāṃ naḥ prabhuścaiva bhaviṣyasi mahābala || 7.11.9 ||
translation: त्वम् you, तु indeed, लङ्केश्वरः lord of Lanka, तात O dear one, भविष्यसि will be, न no, संशयः doubt, त्वया by you, राक्षसवंशः the Rakshasa race, अयम् this, निमग्नः submerged, अपि even, समुद्धृतः uplifted, सर्वेषाम् of all, नः us, प्रभुः lord, च and, एव indeed, भविष्यसि will be, महाबल O mighty one.
explanation: O dear and mighty one, you will undoubtedly be the lord of Lanka, for by you this Rakshasa race, even though submerged, has been uplifted, and you will indeed be the master of all of us.

shloka_text: अथाब्रवीद्दशग्रीवो मातामहमुपस्थितम् । वित्तेशो गुरुरस्माकं नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशम् ।। 7.11.10 ।।
transliteration: athābravīddaśagrīvo mātāmahamupasthitam | vitteśo gururasmākaṃ nārhase vaktumīdṛśam || 7.11.10 ||
translation: अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, दशग्रीवः Ravana, मातामहम् to his maternal grandfather, उपस्थितम् who was present, वित्तेशः Kubera (the lord of wealth), गुरुः preceptor, अस्माकम् our, न not, अर्हसे you ought, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशम् such (a thing).
explanation: Then Ravana spoke to his maternal grandfather, who was present, saying, "Kubera, the lord of wealth, is our preceptor; you ought not to speak such things."

shloka_text: साम्नापि राक्षसेन्द्रेण प्रत्याख्यातो गरीयसा । किञ्चिन्नाह तदा रक्षो ज्ञात्वा तस्य चकीर्षितम् ।। 7.11.11 ।।
transliteration: sāmnāpi rākṣasendreṇa pratyākhyāto garīyasā | kiñcinnāha tadā rakṣo jñātvā tasya cakīrṣitam || 7.11.11 ||
translation: साम्ना even with gentle words, अपि also, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the lord of Rakshasas, गरीयसा who was superior, प्रत्याख्यातः rejected, किञ्चित् anything, न not, आह said, तदा then, रक्षः the Rakshasa (grandfather), ज्ञात्वा having known, तस्य his (Ravana's), चिकीर्षितम् intention.
explanation: Even though the venerable maternal grandfather was rejected by the superior lord of Rakshasas (Ravana) with gentle words, the Rakshasa (grandfather) then said nothing, understanding Ravana's intention.

shloka_text: कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य वसन्तं रावणं ततः । उक्तवन्तं तथा वाक्यं दशग्रीवं निशाचरः ।। 7.11.12 ।।
transliteration: kasyacittvatha kālasya vasantaṃ rāvaṇaṃ tataḥ | uktavantaṃ tathā vākyaṃ daśagrīvaṃ niśācaraḥ || 7.11.12 ||
translation: कस्यचित् of some, तु indeed, अथ then, कालस्य time, वसन्तम् residing, रावणम् to Ravana, ततः then, उक्तवन्तम् who had spoken, तथा such, वाक्यम् words, दशग्रीवम् to Ravana, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (Prahasta).
explanation: Then, after some time, while Ravana was residing there, the night-wanderer (Prahasta) addressed Ravana, who had spoken such words.

shloka_text: प्रहस्तः प्रश्रितं वाक्यमिदमाह स कारणम् ।। 7.11.13 ।।
transliteration: prahastaḥ praśritaṃ vākyamidamāha sa kāraṇam || 7.11.13 ||
translation: प्रहस्तः Prahasta, प्रश्रितम् humble, वाक्यम् words, इदम् these, आह said, सः he, कारणम् with reason.
explanation: Prahasta then spoke these humble and reasonable words.

shloka_text: दशग्रीव महाबाहो नार्हस्त्वं वक्तुमीदृशम् । सौभ्रात्रं नास्ति शूराणां शृणु चेदं वचो मम ।। 7.11.14 ।।
transliteration: daśagrīva mahābāho nārhastvaṃ vaktumīdṛśam | saubhrātraṃ nāsti śūrāṇāṃ śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama || 7.11.14 ||
translation: दशग्रीव O Ravana, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, न not, अर्हसि you ought, त्वम् you, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशम् such (a thing), सौभ्रात्रम् brotherhood, न not, अस्ति exists, शूराणाम् among heroes, शृणु listen, च and, इदम् this, वचः word, मम my.
explanation: O mighty-armed Ravana, you ought not to speak such things, for brotherhood does not exist among heroes; therefore, listen to my words.

shloka_text: अदितिश्च दितिश्चैव भगिन्यौ सहिते हि ते । भार्ये परमरूपिण्यौ कश्यपस्य प्रजापतेः ।। 7.11.15 ।।
transliteration: aditiśca ditiścaiva bhaginyau sahite hi te | bhārye paramarūpiṇyau kaśyapasya prajāpateḥ || 7.11.15 ||
translation: अदितिश्च Aditi and, दितिश्चैव Diti also, भगिन्यौ two sisters, सहिते together, हि indeed, ते they, भार्ये wives, परमरूपिण्यौ of supreme beauty, कश्यपस्य of Kashyapa, प्रजापतेः the Prajapati.
explanation: Aditi and Diti, two sisters of supreme beauty, were indeed the wives of Prajapati Kashyapa.

shloka_text: अदितिर्जनयामास देवांस्त्रिभुवनेश्वरान् । दितिस्त्वजनयत्पुत्रान्कश्यपस्यात्मसम्भवान् ।। 7.11.16 ।।
transliteration: aditirjanayāmāsa devāṃstribhuvaneśvarān | ditistvajanayatputrānkaśyapasyātmasambhavān || 7.11.16 ||
translation: अदितिः Aditi, जनयामास gave birth to, देवान् gods, त्रिभुवनेश्वरान् lords of the three worlds, दितिः Diti, तु but, अजनयत् gave birth to, पुत्रान् sons, कश्यपस्य of Kashyapa, आत्मसम्भवान् born from himself.
explanation: Aditi gave birth to the gods, who became the lords of the three worlds, while Diti bore sons who were also born from Kashyapa.

shloka_text: दैत्यानां किल धर्मज्ञ पुरीयं सवनार्णवा । सपर्वता मही वीर ते ऽभवन्प्रभविष्णवः ।। 7.11.17 ।।
transliteration: daityānāṃ kila dharmajña purīyaṃ savanārṇavā | saparvatā mahī vīra te 'bhavanprabhaviṣṇavaḥ || 7.11.17 ||
translation: दैत्यानां of the Daityas, किल indeed, धर्मज्ञ O knower of Dharma, पुरी realm, इयं this, सवनार्णवा with forests and oceans, सपर्वता with mountains, मही earth, वीर O hero, ते they, अभवन् became, प्रभविष्णवः powerful.
explanation: O knower of Dharma and O hero, this entire earth, with its forests, oceans, and mountains, was indeed the realm of the powerful Daityas.

shloka_text: निहत्य तांस्तु समरे विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना । देवानां वशमानीतं त्रैलोक्यमिदमव्ययम् ।। 7.11.18 ।।
transliteration: nihatya tāṃstu samare viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā | devānāṃ vaśamānītaṃ trailokyamidamavyayam || 7.11.18 ||
translation: निहत्य having killed, तान् them, तु but, समरे in battle, विष्णुना by Vishnu, प्रभविष्णुना the powerful, देवानां of the gods, वशम् under control, आनीतम् brought, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, इदम् this, अव्ययम् imperishable.
explanation: However, the powerful Vishnu, having slain them in battle, brought this imperishable three worlds under the control of the gods.

shloka_text: नैतदेको भवानेव करिष्यति विपर्ययम् । सुरासुरैराचरितं तत्कुरुष्व वचो मम ।। 7.11.19 ।।
transliteration: naitadeko bhavāneva kariṣyati viparyayam | surāsurairācaritaṃ tatkuruṣva vaco mama || 7.11.19 ||
translation: न not, एतत् this, एकः alone, भवान् you, एव only, करिष्यति will do, विपर्ययम् reversal, सुरासुरैः by gods and asuras, आचरितम् practiced, तत् that, कुरुष्व do, वचः word, मम my.
explanation: You alone will not be able to reverse this established order, which has been practiced by both gods and asuras, so please heed my advice.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रहृष्टेनान्तरात्मना । चिन्तयित्वा मुहूर्तं वै बाढमित्येव सो ऽब्रवीत् ।। 7.11.20 ।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā | cintayitvā muhūrtaṃ vai bāḍhamityeva so 'bravīt || 7.11.20 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रहृष्टेन delighted, अन्तरात्मना by his inner self, चिन्तयित्वा having thought, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, वै indeed, बाढम् very well, इति thus, एव only, सः he, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: Thus addressed, Ravana, with his inner self delighted, thought for a moment and then said, "Very well."

shloka_text: स तु तेनैव हर्षेण तस्मिन्नहनि वीर्यवान् । वनं गतो दशग्रीवः सह तैः क्षणदाचरैः ।। 7.11.21 ।।
transliteration: sa tu tenaiva harṣeṇa tasminnahani vīryavān | vanaṃ gato daśagrīvaḥ saha taiḥ kṣaṇadācaraiḥ || 7.11.21 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, तेन by that, एव only, हर्षेण by joy, तस्मिन् on that, अहनि day, वीर्यवान् powerful, वनम् to the forest, गतः went, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, सह with, तैः those, क्षणदाचरैः night-wanderers.
explanation: Indeed, on that very day, the powerful Ravana, filled with that joy, went to the forest with those night-wanderers.

shloka_text: त्रिकूटस्थः स तु तदा दशग्रीवो निशाचरः । प्रेषयामास दौत्येन प्रहस्तं वाक्यकोविदम् ।। 7.11.22 ।।
transliteration: trikūṭasthaḥ sa tu tadā daśagrīvo niśācaraḥ | preṣayāmāsa dautyena prahastaṃ vākyakovidam || 7.11.22 ||
translation: त्रिकूटस्थः situated on Trikuta mountain, सः he, तु indeed, तदा then, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, प्रेषयामास sent, दौत्येन as an envoy, प्रहस्तम् Prahasta, वाक्यकोविदम् skilled in speech.
explanation: Then, Ravana, the night-wanderer, who was situated on Trikuta mountain, sent Prahasta, who was skilled in speech, as an envoy.

shloka_text: प्रहस्त शीघ्रं गच्छ त्वं ब्रूहि नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवम् । वचसा मम वित्तेशं सामपूर्वमिदं वचः ।। 7.11.23 ।।
transliteration: prahasta śīghraṃ gaccha tvaṃ brūhi nairṛtapuṅgavam | vacasā mama vitteśaṃ sāmapūrvamidaṃ vacaḥ || 7.11.23 ||
translation: प्रहस्त O Prahasta, शीघ्रम् quickly, गच्छ go, त्वम् you, ब्रूहि tell, नैर्ऋतपुङ्गवम् to the chief of the Rakshasas, वचसा with the word, मम my, वित्तेशम् to the lord of wealth, सामपूर्वम् preceded by conciliation, इदम् this, वचः word.
explanation: "O Prahasta, go quickly and tell the lord of wealth, the chief of the Rakshasas, these conciliatory words from me."

shloka_text: इयं लङ्का पुरी राजन्राक्षसानां महात्मनाम् । त्वया निवेशिता सौम्य नैतद्युक्तं तवानघ ।। 7.11.24 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ laṅkā purī rājanrākṣasānāṃ mahātmanām | tvayā niveśitā saumya naitadyuktaṃ tavānagha || 7.11.24 ||
translation: इयम् this, लङ्का Lanka, पुरी city, राजन् O King, राक्षसानाम् of the Rakshasas, महात्मनाम् great-souled, त्वया by you, निवेशिता established, सौम्य O gentle one, न not, एतत् this, युक्तम् proper, तव for you, अनघ O sinless one.
explanation: "O King, O gentle one, O sinless one, this city of Lanka, belonging to the great-souled Rakshasas, was established by you, but this is not proper for you."

shloka_text: तद्भवान्यदि नो ह्यद्य दद्यादतुलविक्रम । कृता भवेन्मम प्रीतिर्धुर्मश्चैवानुपालितः ।। 7.11.25 ।।
transliteration: tadbhavānyadi no hyadya dadyādatulavikrama | kṛtā bhavenmama prītirdhurmaścaivānupālitaḥ || 7.11.25 ||
translation: तत् therefore, भवान् you, यदि if, नः to us, हि indeed, अद्य today, दद्यात् would give, अतुलविक्रम O unequalled in valor, कृता done, भवेत् would be, मम my, प्रीतिः satisfaction, धर्मः duty, च and, एव indeed, अनुपालितः fulfilled.
explanation: O unequalled in valor, if you would indeed give it to us today, my satisfaction would be complete, and my duty would also be fulfilled.

shloka_text: स तु गत्वा पुरीं लङ्कां धनदेन सुरक्षिताम् । अब्रवीत्परमोदारं वित्तपालमिदं वचः ।। 7.11.26 ।।
transliteration: sa tu gatvā purīṃ laṅkāṃ dhanadena surakṣitām | abravītparamodāraṃ vittapālamidaṃ vacaḥ || 7.11.26 ||
translation: सः he, तु indeed, गत्वा having gone, पुरीम् to the city, लङ्काम् Lanka, धनदेन by Kubera, सुरक्षिताम् well-protected, अब्रवीत् spoke, परमोदारम् to the most generous, वित्तपालम् lord of wealth, इदम् this, वचः word.
explanation: Having arrived at the city of Lanka, which was well-protected by Kubera, the messenger then spoke these words to the most generous lord of wealth.

shloka_text: प्रेषितो ऽहं तव भ्रात्रा दशग्रीवेण सुव्रत । त्वत्समीपं महाबाहो सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वर ।। 7.11.27 ।।
transliteration: preṣito 'haṃ tava bhrātrā daśagrīveṇa suvrata | tvatsamīpaṃ mahābāho sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ vara || 7.11.27 ||
translation: प्रेषितः sent, अहम् I, तव your, भ्रात्रा by brother, दशग्रीवेण by Dashagriva, सुव्रत O one of good vows, त्वत्समीपम् to your presence, महाबाहो O mighty-armed, सर्वशस्त्रभृताम् among all weapon-bearers, वर O best.
explanation: O one of good vows, O mighty-armed, O best among all weapon-bearers, I have been sent to your presence by your brother, Dashagriva.

shloka_text: तच्छ्रूयतां महाप्राज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद । वचनं मम वित्तेश यद्ब्रवीति दशाननः ।। 7.11.28 ।।
transliteration: tacchrūyatāṃ mahāprājña sarvaśāstraviśārada | vacanaṃ mama vitteśa yadbravīti daśānanaḥ || 7.11.28 ||
translation: तत् that, श्रूयताम् let it be heard, महाप्राज्ञ O greatly wise one, सर्वशास्त्रविशारद O expert in all scriptures, वचनम् message, मम my, वित्तेश O lord of wealth, यत् which, ब्रवीति says, दशाननः Dashanana.
explanation: O greatly wise one, O expert in all scriptures, O lord of wealth, please listen to my message, which Dashanana (Ravana) conveys.

shloka_text: इयं किल पुरी रम्या सुमालिप्रमुखैः पुरा । भुक्तपूर्वा विशालाक्ष राक्षसैर्भीमविक्रमैः ।। 7.11.29 ।।
transliteration: iyaṃ kila purī ramyā sumālipramukhaiḥ purā | bhuktapūrvā viśālākṣa rākṣasairbhīmavikramaiḥ || 7.11.29 ||
translation: इयम् this, किल indeed, पुरी city, रम्य beautiful, सुमालिप्रमुखैः by Sumali and others, पुरा formerly, भुक्तपूर्वा previously enjoyed, विशालाक्ष O wide-eyed one, राक्षसैः by Rakshasas, भीमविक्रमैः of terrible valor.
explanation: O wide-eyed one, this beautiful city was indeed formerly inhabited by Rakshasas of terrible valor, led by Sumali and others.

shloka_text: तेन विज्ञाप्यते सो ऽयं साम्प्रतं विश्रवात्मज । तदेषा दीयतां तात याचतस्तस्य सामतः ।। 7.11.30 ।।
transliteration: tena vijñāpyate so 'yaṃ sāmprataṃ viśravātmaja | tadeṣā dīyatāṃ tāta yācatastasya sāmataḥ || 7.11.30 ||
translation: तेन by him, विज्ञाप्यते is being requested, सः he, अयम् this, साम्प्रतम् now, विश्रवात्मज O son of Vishrava, तत् therefore, एषा this (Lanka), दीयताम् let it be given, तात dear one, याचतः of him who is requesting, तस्य his, सामतः by peaceful means.
explanation: Prahasta requests Kubera, the son of Vishrava, to peacefully hand over Lanka to Ravana, who is now asking for it.

shloka_text: प्रहस्तादभिसंश्रुत्य देवो वैश्रवणो वचः । प्रत्युवाच प्रहस्तं तं वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः ।। 7.11.31 ।।
transliteration: prahastādabhisaṃśrutya devo vaiśravaṇo vacaḥ | pratyuvāca prahastaṃ taṃ vākyaṃ vākyaviśāradaḥ || 7.11.31 ||
translation: प्रहस्तात् from Prahasta, अभिसंश्रुत्य having heard well, देवः the god, वैश्रवणः Vaishravana, वचः the words, प्रत्युवाच replied, प्रहस्तम् to Prahasta, तम् him, वाक्यम् words, वाक्यविशारदः skilled in speech.
explanation: The god Vaishravana, who was skilled in speech, having heard Prahasta's words, replied to him.

shloka_text: दत्ता ममेयं पित्रा तु लङ्का शून्या निशाचरैः । निवासिते च मे यक्षैर्दानमानादिभिर्गुणैः ।। 7.11.32 ।।
transliteration: dattā mameyaṃ pitrā tu laṅkā śūnyā niśācaraiḥ | nivāsite ca me yakṣairdānamānādibhirguṇaiḥ || 7.11.32 ||
translation: दत्ता given, मम to me, इयम् this, पित्रा by father, तु indeed, लङ्का Lanka, शून्या empty, निशाचरैः of night-wanderers, निवासिते settled, च and, मे by me, यक्षैः by Yakshas, दानमानादिभिः by gifts, honors, etc., गुणैः by means.
explanation: Kubera stated that his father had given him this Lanka, which was empty of Rakshasas, and he had settled it with Yakshas through various means like gifts and honors.

shloka_text: ब्रूहि गच्छ दशग्रीवं पुरं राज्यं च यन्मम । तवाप्येतन्महाबाहो भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यमकण्टकम् ।। 7.11.33 ।।
transliteration: brūhi gaccha daśagrīvaṃ puraṃ rājyaṃ ca yanmama | tavāpyetanmahābāho bhuṅkṣva rājyamakaṇṭakam || 7.11.33 ||
translation: ब्रूहि tell, गच्छ go, दशग्रीवम् to Dashagriva, पुरम् the city, राज्यम् the kingdom, च and, यत् which, मम is mine, तव yours, अपि also, एतत् this, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy, राज्यम् the kingdom, अकण्टकम् unhindered.
explanation: Kubera instructed Prahasta to go and tell Ravana that the city and kingdom which were his, were now also Ravana's, and he should enjoy this unhindered kingdom, O mighty-armed one.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा धनाध्यक्षो जगाम पितुरन्तिकम् ।। 7.11.34 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā dhanādhyakṣo jagāma piturantikam || 7.11.34 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, धनाध्यक्षः the lord of wealth, जगाम went, पितुः of his father, अन्तिकम् to the presence.
explanation: Having spoken thus, Kubera, the lord of wealth, went to his father's presence.

shloka_text: अभिवाद्य गुरुं प्राह रावणस्य यदीप्सितम् । एष तात दशग्रीवो दूतं प्रेषितवान्मम ।। 7.11.35 ।।
transliteration: abhivādya guruṃ prāha rāvaṇasya yadīpsitam | eṣa tāta daśagrīvo dūtaṃ preṣitavānmama || 7.11.35 ||
translation: अभिवाद्य having saluted, गुरुं the preceptor, प्राह he said, रावणस्य of Ravana, यदीप्सितम् what is desired, एष this, तात O father, दशग्रीवो Dashagriva, दूतं a messenger, प्रेषितवान्मम has sent to me.
explanation: Having saluted his father, Kubera informed him of Ravana's demand, saying, "O father, Dashagriva has sent a messenger to me with his desire."

shloka_text: दीयतां नगरी लङ्का पूर्वं रक्षोगणोषिता । मयात्र यदनुष्ठेयं तन्ममाचक्ष्व सुव्रत ।। 7.11.36 ।।
transliteration: dīyatāṃ nagarī laṅkā pūrvaṃ rakṣogaṇoṣitā | mayātra yadanuṣṭheyaṃ tanmamācakṣva suvrata || 7.11.36 ||
translation: दीयतां let it be given, नगरी the city, लङ्का Lanka, पूर्वं formerly, रक्षोगणोषिता inhabited by Rakshasas, मयात्र by me here, यदनुष्ठेयं what is to be done, तन्ममाचक्ष्व that tell me, सुव्रत O one of good vows.
explanation: Kubera further stated, "Let the city of Lanka, formerly inhabited by Rakshasas, be given to him; please tell me, O revered one, what I should do in this situation."

shloka_text: ब्रह्मर्षिस्त्वेवमुक्तो ऽसौ विश्रवा मुनिपुङ्गवः । प्राञ्जलिं धनदं प्राह शृणु पुत्र वचो मम ।। 7.11.37 ।।
transliteration: brahmarṣistvevamukto 'sau viśravā munipuṅgavaḥ | prāñjaliṃ dhanadaṃ prāha śṛṇu putra vaco mama || 7.11.37 ||
translation: ब्रह्मर्षिस्त्वेवमुक्तो the Brahmarshi, thus addressed, असौ he, विश्रवा Vishrava, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages, प्राञ्जलिं to the one with folded hands, धनदं to Kubera, प्राह said, शृणु listen, पुत्र O son, वचो words, मम my.
explanation: Thus addressed, the Brahmarshi Vishrava, the foremost among sages, spoke to Kubera, who stood with folded hands, saying, "Listen, O son, to my words."

shloka_text: दशग्रीवो महाबाहुरुक्तवान्मम सन्निधौ । मया निर्भर्त्सितश्चासीद्बहुशोक्तः सुदुर्मतिः ।। 7.11.38 ।।
transliteration: daśagrīvo mahābāhuruktavānmama sannidhau | mayā nirbhartsitaścāsīdbahuśoktaḥ sudurmatiḥ || 7.11.38 ||
translation: दशग्रीवो Dashagriva, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, उक्तवान्मम spoke to me, सन्निधौ in my presence, मया by me, निर्भर्त्सितश्चासीद् he was rebuked, बहुशोक्तः much admonished, सुदुर्मतिः the evil-minded one.
explanation: Vishrava recounted that the mighty-armed, evil-minded Dashagriva had spoken to him in his presence, and he had repeatedly rebuked and admonished him.

shloka_text: स क्रोधेन मया चोक्तो ध्वंसते च पुनः पुनः । श्रेयो ऽभियुक्तं धर्म्यं च शृणु पुत्र वचो मम ।। 7.11.39 ।।
transliteration: sa krodhena mayā cokto dhvaṃsate ca punaḥ punaḥ | śreyo 'bhiyuktaṃ dharmyaṃ ca śṛṇu putra vaco mama || 7.11.39 ||
translation: स he, क्रोधेन with anger, मया by me, चोक्तो was told, ध्वंसते he perishes, च and, पुनः पुनः again and again, श्रेयो welfare, अभियुक्तं connected with, धर्म्यं righteous, च and, शृणु listen, पुत्र O son, वचो words, मम my.
explanation: Vishrava continued, "Though I spoke to him with anger, warning him that he would repeatedly perish, now listen, O son, to my words which are conducive to your welfare and righteousness."

shloka_text: वरप्रदानसम्मूढो मान्या ऽमान्यान् स दुर्मतिः । न वेत्ति मम शापाच्च प्रकृतिं दारुणां गतः ।। 7.11.40 ।।
transliteration: varapradānasammūḍho mānyā 'mānyān sa durmatiḥ | na vetti mama śāpācca prakṛtiṃ dāruṇāṃ gataḥ || 7.11.40 ||
translation: वरप्रदानसम्मूढो bewildered by the granting of boons, मान्या those who are respectable, अमान्यान् those who are not respectable, सः he, दुर्मतिः evil-minded, न वेत्ति does not distinguish, मम my, शापात् from the curse, च and, प्रकृतिम् nature, दारुणाम् terrible, गतः attained.
explanation: Bewildered by the boons, that evil-minded one does not distinguish between the respectable and the disrespectful, and furthermore, he has attained a terrible nature due to my curse.

shloka_text: तस्माद्गच्छ महाबाहो कैलासं धरणीधरम् । निवेशय निवासार्थं त्यक्त्वा लङ्कां सहानुगः ।। 7.11.41 ।।
transliteration: tasmādgaccha mahābāho kailāsaṃ dharaṇīdharam | niveśaya nivāsārthaṃ tyaktvā laṅkāṃ sahānugaḥ || 7.11.41 ||
translation: तस्मात् therefore, गच्छ go, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, कैलासं to Kailasa, धरणीधरम् the mountain, निवेशय establish, निवासार्थं for residence, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, लङ्कां Lanka, सहानुगः with your followers.
explanation: Therefore, O mighty-armed one, go to the mountain Kailasa, abandon Lanka, and establish your residence there with your followers.

shloka_text: तत्र मन्दाकिनी रम्या नदीनामुत्तमा नदी । काञ्चनैः सूर्यसङ्काशैः पङ्कजैः संवृतोदका ।। 7.11.42 ।।
transliteration: tatra mandākinī ramyā nadīnāmuttamā nadī | kāñcanaiḥ sūryasaṅkāśaiḥ paṅkajaiḥ saṃvṛtodakā || 7.11.42 ||
translation: तत्र there, मन्दाकिनी Mandakini, रम्या beautiful, नदीनाम् among rivers, उत्तमा best, नदी river, काञ्चनैः with golden, सूर्यसङ्काशैः resembling the sun, पङ्कजैः with lotuses, संवृतोदका whose waters are covered.
explanation: There flows the beautiful Mandakini river, the best among rivers, whose waters are covered with golden lotuses shining like the sun.

shloka_text: कुमुदैरुत्पलैश्चैव तथा ऽन्यैश्च सुगन्धिभिः ।। 7.11.43 ।।
transliteration: kumudairutpalaiścaiva tathā 'nyaiśca sugandhibhiḥ || 7.11.43 ||
translation: कुमुदैः with white water lilies, उत्पलैः with blue lotuses, च and, एव also, तथा similarly, अन्यैः with other, च and, सुगन्धिभिः fragrant ones.
explanation: Its waters are also covered with white water lilies, blue lotuses, and other fragrant flowers.

shloka_text: तत्र देवाः सगन्धर्वाः साप्सरोरगकिंनराः । विहारशीलाः सततं रमन्ते सर्वदा ऽ ऽश्रिताः ।। 7.11.44 ।।
transliteration: tatra devāḥ sagandharvāḥ sāpsaroragakiṃnarāḥ | vihāraśīlāḥ satataṃ ramante sarvadā ' 'śritāḥ || 7.11.44 ||
translation: तत्र there, देवाः gods, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, साप्सरः with Apsaras, उरग serpents, किंनराः Kinnaras, विहारशीलाः fond of sport, सततम् constantly, रमन्ते they delight, सर्वदा always, आश्रिताः residing.
explanation: Gods, along with Gandharvas, Apsaras, Uragas, and Kinnaras, constantly reside there, always delighting in recreation.

shloka_text: न हि क्षमं तवानेन वैरं धनद रक्षसा । जानीषे हि यथा ऽनेन लब्धः परमको वरः ।। 7.11.45 ।।
transliteration: na hi kṣamaṃ tavānena vairaṃ dhanada rakṣasā | jānīṣe hi yathā 'nena labdhaḥ paramako varaḥ || 7.11.45 ||
translation: न not, हि indeed, क्षमं proper, तव for you, अनेन with this, वैरं enmity, धनद O Kubera, रक्षसा demon, जानीषे you know, हि indeed, यथा how, अनेन by him, लब्धः obtained, परमको supreme, वरः boon
explanation: O Kubera, it is indeed not proper for you to have enmity with this demon, for you know well how he has obtained a supreme boon.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो गृहीत्वा ऽ ऽशु तद्वचः पितृगौरवात् । सदारपुत्रः सामान्यः सवाहनधनो गतः ।। 7.11.46 ।।
transliteration: evamukto gṛhītvā ' 'śu tadvacaḥ pitṛgauravāt | sadāraputraḥ sāmānyaḥ savāhanadhano gataḥ || 7.11.46 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तो spoken, गृहीत्वा having taken, आशु quickly, तद्वचः his words, पितृगौरवात् out of respect for his father, सदारपुत्रः with wife and sons, सामान्यः with his retinue, सवाहनधनो with vehicles and wealth, गतः went
explanation: Thus spoken to, Kubera, out of respect for his father, quickly accepted his words and departed with his wife, sons, retinue, vehicles, and wealth.

shloka_text: प्रहस्तो ऽथ दशग्रीवं गत्वा वचनमब्रवीत् । प्रहृष्टात्मा महात्मानं सहामात्यं सहानुजम् ।। 7.11.47 ।।
transliteration: prahasto 'tha daśagrīvaṃ gatvā vacanamabravīt | prahṛṣṭātmā mahātmānaṃ sahāmātyaṃ sahānujam || 7.11.47 ||
translation: प्रहस्तो Prahasta, अथ then, दशग्रीवं to Dashagriva, गत्वा having gone, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, प्रहृष्टात्मा with a joyful heart, महात्मानं to the great-souled one, सहामात्यं with his ministers, सहानुजम् with his younger brothers
explanation: Then Prahasta, with a joyful heart, went to the great-souled Dashagriva, who was with his ministers and younger brothers, and spoke these words.

shloka_text: शून्या सा नगरी लङ्का त्यक्त्त्वैनां धनदो गतः । प्रविश्य तां सहास्माभिः स्वधर्मं प्रतिपालय ।। 7.11.48 ।।
transliteration: śūnyā sā nagarī laṅkā tyakttvaināṃ dhanado gataḥ | praviśya tāṃ sahāsmābhiḥ svadharmaṃ pratipālaya || 7.11.48 ||
translation: शून्या empty, सा that, नगरी city, लङ्का Lanka, त्यक्त्त्वा having abandoned, एनां this, धनदो Kubera, गतः has gone, प्रविश्य having entered, तां that, सहास्माभिः with us, स्वधर्मं your own duty, प्रतिपालय govern
explanation: That city of Lanka is now empty, as Kubera has abandoned it and departed; therefore, enter that city with us and govern according to your own duty.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रहस्तेन महाबलः । विवेश नगरीं लङ्कां भ्रातृभिः सबलानुगैः ।। 7.11.49 ।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ prahastena mahābalaḥ | viveśa nagarīṃ laṅkāṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ sabalānugaiḥ || 7.11.49 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तो spoken, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रहस्तेन by Prahasta, महाबलः the mighty one, विवेश entered, नगरीं city, लङ्कां Lanka, भ्रातृभिः with his brothers, सबलानुगैः with his army and followers
explanation: Thus spoken to by Prahasta, the mighty Dashagriva entered the city of Lanka with his brothers, army, and followers.

shloka_text: धनदेन परित्यक्तां सुविभक्तमहापथाम् । आरुरोह स देवारिः स्वर्गं देवाधिपो यथा ।। 7.11.50 ।।
transliteration: dhanadena parityaktāṃ suvibhaktamahāpathām | āruroha sa devāriḥ svargaṃ devādhipo yathā || 7.11.50 ||
translation: धनदेन by Kubera, परित्यक्ताम् abandoned, सुविभक्तमहापथाम् having well-divided great roads, आरुरोह ascended, सः he, देवारिः the enemy of gods, स्वर्गम् to the heaven-like city, देवाधिपः the lord of gods, यथा just as.
explanation: Ravana, the enemy of the gods, ascended to that city (Lanka), which had well-divided great roads and had been abandoned by Kubera, just as Indra ascends to heaven.

shloka_text: स चाभिषिक्तः क्षणदाचरैस्तदा निवेशयामास पुरीं दशाननः । निकामपूर्णा च बभूव सा पुरी निशाचरैर्नीलबलाहकोपमैः ।। 7.11.51 ।।
transliteration: sa cābhiṣiktaḥ kṣaṇadācaraistadā niveśayāmāsa purīṃ daśānanaḥ | nikāmapūrṇā ca babhūva sā purī niśācarairnīlabalāhakopamaiḥ || 7.11.51 ||
translation: सः he, च and, अभिषिक्तः having been crowned, क्षणदाचरैः by the night-wanderers, तदा then, निवेशयामास populated, पुरीम् the city, दशाननः Ravana, निकामपूर्णा completely filled, च and, बभूव became, सा that, पुरी city, निशाचरैः by night-wanderers, नीलबलाहकोपमैः resembling dark clouds.
explanation: After being crowned by the Rakshasas, Ravana then populated that city, and it became completely filled with night-wanderers resembling dark clouds.

shloka_text: धनेश्वरस्त्वथ पितृवाक्यगौरवान्न्यवेशयच्छशिविमले गिरौ पुरीम् । स्वलङ्कृतैर्भवनवरैर्विभूषितां पुरन्दरस्वेव तदा ऽमरावतीम् ।। 7.11.52 ।।
transliteration: dhaneśvarastvatha pitṛvākyagauravānnyaveśayacchaśivimale girau purīm | svalaṅkṛtairbhavanavarairvibhūṣitāṃ purandarasveva tadā 'marāvatīm || 7.11.52 ||
translation: धनेश्वरः Kubera, तु but, अथ then, पितृवाक्यगौरवात् out of respect for his father's words, न्यवेशयत् established, शशिविमले on the moon-bright, गिरौ mountain, पुरीम् a city, स्वलङ्कृतैः well-decorated, भवनवरैः with excellent mansions, विभूषिताम् adorned, पुरन्दरस्य of Indra, इव like, तदा then, अमरावतीम् Amaravati.
explanation: But then Kubera, out of respect for his father's words, established a city on the moon-bright mountain (Kailasa), adorned with well-decorated excellent mansions, just like Indra's Amaravati. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकादशः सर्गः ।। 11 ।। Thus ends the eleventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
